operations.title: Every intrinsic prime-power mode adds a negative Pick direction
operations.statement: In Im(z)>1/2 the functional equation moves the theta Weyl function into the Euler half-plane. Adding one prime-power term delta M=-i a exp(izL) changes the diagonal Pick kernel at z=iy by -a exp(-yL)/y<0. Hence prime cutoff refinement cannot be addition of positive RKHS features; it necessarily enters the indefinite boundary preshape.
operations.scope: Exact no-go for monotone positive prime-feature refinement; indefinite cutoffs with a globally renormalized positive quotient remain open.
